landing.title: TOON EXPO Invest 2026 Vol. 2
paragraphs: From November 13 to 15, Armenia will host one of the largest international real estate and investment exhibitions — TOON EXPO Invest 2026 Vol. 2.

The exhibition will bring together leading companies in real estate and construction on one platform — developers, real estate agencies, financial organizations, and other companies related to the industry.
During TOON EXPO Invest 2026 Vol. 2, visitors will have the opportunity to explore new projects, special offers, investment opportunities, and the latest offerings on the real estate market.

privacy.title: Policy on the collection, use, storage, and processing of personal data
privacy.intro: This Policy describes the procedure by which TOON EXPO collects, uses, stores, and processes your (the Users’) personal data in accordance with applicable legal norms. By participating in TOON EXPO and making the relevant mark in the electronic and/or paper notice presented to you, you consent to the collection, storage, and transfer of your personal data (to the range of persons specified in this Policy) as set out in this Policy, and you agree to their processing in accordance with applicable data protection legislation.

sections.title: 1. Data processed
sections.body:
Within the scope of this Policy, the User’s personal information includes:

1.1 Personal information that the User provides about themselves when completing and submitting application forms, subscribing to updates, or using the Services.

1.2 Data automatically transmitted to the Website’s services during use via software installed on the User’s device (IP address, cookie files, browser data, date and time of access).

1.3 This Privacy Policy applies only to the toonexpo.com Website. The Website does not control and is not responsible for third-party websites that the User may visit through links available on the Website.

During your registration and participation in TOON EXPO, we collect and process the following categories of personal data.
items: Basic information (required for registration): first name, last name, email address, phone number, date of birth.
Professional information: company / organization, position / role, industry / sector, and similar.
Technical data: IP addresses, device data, browser type, and usage patterns automatically collected when you use our website.
Feedback data: information voluntarily provided through inquiries and feedback forms.

App usage data: when using the official TOON EXPO mobile application, we may collect data about your interaction with the app (features used, session duration, preferences, accessible content). This may also include technical data (for example, advertising identifiers and error logs).

sections.title: 2. Purposes of data processing and related actions
sections.body:
2.1 Event management: enabling your registration, coordinating logistics, providing updates and messages, and addressing security matters.

2.2 Optimizing event engagement: tracking participation and interactions to improve the TOON EXPO experience.

2.3 Analytics: creating anonymous statistics for internal analysis to improve future events.

2.4 Application features and personalization: providing, personalizing, and improving TOON EXPO mobile application features (personalized schedules, networking tools, and similar).

2.5 Identifying visitors’ needs and interests and providing relevant offers: processing visitors’ personal data to identify their needs and interests, to provide matching information and offers regarding goods and services, and to ensure effective communication with TOON EXPO partner organizations. By reviewing this Policy and making the relevant “I agree” mark during registration, the User consents to the processing of personal data for these purposes and to its transfer to TOON EXPO partner organizations in the manner and under the conditions set out in clause 5.1 of this Policy.

sections.title: 3. Legal bases for processing
sections.body:
We process your personal data on the following legal bases.

3.1 Legitimate interests: ensuring uninterrupted TOON EXPO operations and improving the participant experience.

3.2 Legal compliance: personal data is processed in accordance with the requirements of applicable legal norms and legislative acts and the principles they establish, including, but not limited to, the RA Law “On Protection of Personal Data”.

sections.title: 4. Data retention
sections.body: We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to achieve the purposes stated in this policy. Data that is no longer needed is securely deleted or anonymized.

sections.title: 5. Transfer of personal data
sections.body:
5.1 Partner and/or participating companies. To properly achieve the purposes set out in Section 2 of this Policy, your personal data may be transferred to TOON EXPO partner and/or participating companies (for processing, including, but not limited to, use and contacting Users through them, including by phone calls, email notifications and messages (SMS), and other means of communication, in order to deliver information to Users). The full list of these companies is available in the relevant section of the website.

5.2 Legal compliance. Data may be provided to law-enforcement or regulatory authorities in cases established by law.

5.3 Business transfer. In the event of a merger or sale, data may be transferred to the new organization.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
sections.body: In connection with the processing of your personal data, you have the right to:
items: Obtain information at any time about your personal data and the processes of its processing;
Request at any time that your personal data be rectified, blocked, or destroyed if it is incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated;
Request at any time that the processing of your personal data be restricted;
Withdraw your consent at any time;
Exercise other rights related to data processing provided by law.
sections.closing: To exercise the rights set out above, please contact us using the contact details listed on the website or write to us at info@bigprojects.am. If a deletion (destruction) or withdrawal request is submitted, your data will be deleted within 3 (three) business days after receipt of the request without any consequences.

sections.title: 7. Changes to the policy
sections.body: We reserve the right to change this policy at any time. You will be notified of material changes through the website.

sections.title: 8. Use of cookie files
sections.body: We use cookies to improve website performance, analyze usage trends, and personalize advertising.

sections.title: 9. Contact
sections.body:
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, you may contact:
